## Step 10ag (installed 2026-09-18 01:19 UTC): bounded review history, context bound is a failure, yield backoff, dependency-pending lane
Measured 2026-09-18 00:56 UTC after 13 idle hours (76 merged, 1 blocked): (1) Team 5 / UI-48 — the reviewer's TDD context rendered five historical runs of the thrice-recalled package (93k characters of receipts) → `fit_context` CONTEXT_CAPACITY_UNSUPPORTED on every claim; `defer_failure` matched 'CAPACITY' and yielded PACKAGE_CAPACITY_WAIT; the scheduler re-admitted the team every ~10 s: 4,762 CLAIM/RETRY events, one model call. (2) Team 1 / UI-54 — examples.tsx imports ../empty/Empty (UI-44, same team, merged 08:24, after the candidate failed at 02:22); the candidate (green root + UI-54 only) failed as vite 'Failed to resolve import' → TDD_BROWSER_INFRASTRUCTURE with NEEDS_TRIAGE; `_refresh_lane` never retries blocks that carry a handoff → root waited COMPONENT_DELIVERY_BLOCKED_WAIT since 12:47.
- factory_delivery_coordinator `_bound_history`: two most recent historical runs detailed, older ones summarized (run id, completion digest, cycle count, test paths), revision diffs cut at 6000 chars, rendered history ≤ 40k; every run is still hash-validated (tampering still stops before the provider). UI-48 context: 93k → ~22k.
- factory_autonomy_delivery `defer_failure`: only `<NAME>_CAPACITY[_WAIT|_UNAVAILABLE]` messages are waits (account/provider/package/port); CONTEXT_CAPACITY_UNSUPPORTED and INVALID_RUNTIME_CAPACITY_POLICY fail the stage visibly.
- factory_scheduler `_repeated_yield_backoff`: a child that yielded the same PACKAGE_CAPACITY_WAIT checkpoint digest 4× within 15 min is re-admitted 2 min after its last yield (waiting=PACKAGE_CAPACITY_BACKOFF).
- factory_component_delivery `classify_dependency`/`_missing_dependency`: an ERROR candidate regression whose artifact says `Failed to resolve import "<relative>" from "<own file>"` and whose resolved module lies in another package's write_paths gets handoff status DEPENDENCY_PENDING (+dependency_plan_id/package_id, missing_module); `_eligible` counts such a row once the dependency's delivery is MERGED (current evidence) and `_refresh_lane` releases it once (owner_events component-dependency-release). deploy10ag.py `reclassify` applied it to the live UI-54 row (dependency UI-44, module …/components/empty/Empty).
- Tests +7 (review context 3, worker integration 1 parametrized, scheduler 1, component delivery 2); regression baseline 502 passed, 2 known + 3 test_blockage_checkpoint_database failures that also fail on the untouched live tree (BLOCKAGE_FINALIZE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED), 1 pre-existing test_package_review_tdd_context failure (double `_release_pulse` in accept).

## Step 10al (installed 2026-09-18 10:13 UTC): controller execution of a submitted request is not agent idleness
07:21–10:09: the root's integration suite grew from 570 s to ~70 minutes (the public barrel now publishes all 73 components, so every browser test loads a much larger bundle). `tdd.poll()` executes the submitted request inside the agent-call loop with `protocol_guard` as the harness guard, and `ProgressWatchdog` counts only new controller test receipts as progress — so each request killed its own agent call at the 600 s idle bound (AGENT_PROGRESS_STALLED), the stage failed, recovery restarted it, and on the third occurrence recovery hit RECOVERY_RETRY_BOUND and the root sat in ERROR with no repairer.
- factory_worker: the loop marks the controller-execution window around `tdd.poll()`.
- factory_progress `controller_busy` + `_now`: both the idle and the absolute call timers freeze for exactly that window, and `summary()` reports `controller_execution_seconds`. Controller-side hangs remain bounded by the harness's per-run timeouts and the stage lease, not by this idle timer.
- Tests +4 (test_progress 3, test_worker_progress 1). Regression: 527 passed with the 2 known baseline failures.
- Root resumed (receipt 0ed5bb87…); hold off 10:13.
- Open capacity item: the browser runner executes its 50-test batches sequentially (one container at a time) while the VM sits near 19% CPU; parallel batches would cut the ~70 minute suite several-fold, but the runner digest is qualification-covered, so it needs a real-container requalification.

### P0-4 — Yönetim kaydı ile gerçek onarım arasında eksik yürütme adımı

Push/pull gözlem, sorumlu ataması ve eskalasyon var. Fakat profilsiz teşhisten yeni onarımın hazırlanması → bağımsız doğrulanması → uygulanması → eski işin güvenli devamı zinciri genel olarak tamamlanmış değil.

`record_repair_observation` bir ART kaydı yazar; **worker başlatmaz**. Risk OWNED, kayıt SENT, çağrı COMPLETED veya handoff COMPLETE tek başına onarım/ürün başarısı değildir.
